meta.description: Triggered by the HRIS People tab 'Missing Bank Info → Notify' button. Accepts a single recipient or a batch (to / recipient_email / emails[] / recipients[], up to 2000), acks immediately, then emails each person a red-alarm alert (CTA → https://bank-payout-update.vercel.app/update-bank-info) in throttled batches (SplitInBatches batchSize 10 + 1s Throttle, ~10/s; one bad address doesn't stop the rest). Subject/body/URL are fixed in the Build Recipients node (callers choose only WHO is emailed). Attach a Gmail OAuth2 credential to the send node before activating; optionally set REQUIRED_SECRET in Build Recipients + N8N_BANK_INFO_NOTIFY_SECRET in the HRIS to lock the webhook.
